summary: Williams Harbour Airport (YWM) is a small airport serving the remote coastal community of Williams Harbour in Labrador, Canada. The airport provides essential air access for residents of this isolated fishing settlement on the Labrador coast. As a small regional airport, it primarily handles local flights that connect the community to larger centres in the region.
